_about: THE MODEL REEL, approved by Abr on 23 Oct 2026 (Thaaranira cast-puzzle, 14.4 s); on-screen text switched to English on 24 Oct 2026 at his request (the voice stays Malayalam). Copy its shape for every reel: a hook that is on screen from frame 0 and asks the viewer something, one short Malayalam voice line per beat with the matching English item landing on that line, a countdown, the reveal, a comment question, then the CTA. Sounds are added by the renderer. shot.png comes from shoot.py.
